reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co., because I have nothing to check it against. There are no Brackenwater account files I can see (contract, CRM or profile), and the account hasn't come up in #central-team before.

In the reply I said I'd treat the date as unverified. I suggested she get it confirmed in writing by her Brackenwater contact or check it against the signed contract before anyone plans around it. I also asked her to post the confirmation in the channel if she gets one.
